s0001.literal: On the second day of the eighth month, the Prince of Jin hunted at Tula. Teshi secretly sent Walaosi to report, saying, "I, together with Hasan, Yesen Temür, and Shitu'er, have settled our plot. When the affair succeeds, we shall install Your Highness as emperor.
s0001.idiomatic: On the second day of the eighth month, the Prince of Jin hunted at Tula. Teshi secretly sent Walaosi to report, saying, "I, together with Hasan, Yesen Temür, and Shitu'er, have settled our plot. When the affair succeeds, we shall install Your Highness as emperor.

s0002.literal: " He also ordered Walaosi to inform Dilqash of the matter, saying further, "You and Masihu are to know of this — do not let Xumaijie hear of it.
s0002.idiomatic: " He also ordered Walaosi to inform Dilqash of the matter, saying further, "You and Masihu are to know of this — do not let Xumaijie hear of it.

s0003.literal: " Thereupon the prince ordered Walaosi imprisoned and dispatched Bielie Mishi and others to Shangdu to report the treasonous plot; they had not yet arrived.
s0003.idiomatic: " Thereupon the prince ordered Walaosi imprisoned and dispatched Bielie Mishi and others to Shangdu to report the treasonous plot; they had not yet arrived.

s0004.literal: On guihai day Emperor Yingzong returned south and halted at Nancha.
s0004.idiomatic: On guihai day Emperor Yingzong returned south and halted at Nancha.

s0005.literal: That evening, Teshi and others falsely executed Baizhu, and Emperor Yingzong was then assassinated in the tent-palace.
s0005.idiomatic: That evening, Teshi and others falsely executed Baizhu, and Emperor Yingzong was then assassinated in the tent-palace.

s0006.literal: Princes Atipeihua and Yesen Temür, bearing the imperial seal and cord, went north to welcome Prince of Jin Yesun Temür at his garrison station.
s0006.idiomatic: Princes Atipeihua and Yesen Temür, bearing the imperial seal and cord, went north to welcome Prince of Jin Yesun Temür at his garrison station.

s0007.literal: Ninth month, on guisi day, he acceded to the throne at Longju River and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
s0007.idiomatic: Ninth month, on guisi day, he acceded to the throne at Longju River and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

s0009.literal: Emperor Sechen graciously viewed his legitimate grandson, eldest son of Emperor Yuzong, my merciful grandfather Gammala — I was enfeoffed Prince of Jin, put in charge of Chinggis Khan's four great ordos, and entrusted with troops and horses and all Dadu territory.
s0009.idiomatic: Emperor Sechen graciously viewed his legitimate grandson, eldest son of Emperor Yuzong, my merciful grandfather Gammala — I was enfeoffed Prince of Jin, put in charge of Chinggis Khan's four great ordos, and entrusted with troops and horses and all Dadu territory.

s0010.literal: Following Emperor Sechen's holy edict, I behaved with care and caution; in whatever business of armies, horses, and people, I maintained the correct path, and for several years the common people attained peaceful livelihoods.
s0010.idiomatic: Following Emperor Sechen's holy edict, I behaved with care and caution; in whatever business of armies, horses, and people, I maintained the correct path, and for several years the common people attained peaceful livelihoods.

s0011.literal: Later, Emperor Wanze Du instructed me to inherit the succession and entrusted me in the great ordo.
s0011.idiomatic: Later, Emperor Wanze Du instructed me to inherit the succession and entrusted me in the great ordo.

s0012.literal: Having been entrusted, I guarded the great encampment and supported my two elder brothers Emperors Qutuqtu and Buyan Toq, and my nephew Emperor Shidebala.
s0012.idiomatic: Having been entrusted, I guarded the great encampment and supported my two elder brothers Emperors Qutuqtu and Buyan Toq, and my nephew Emperor Shidebala.

s0013.literal: Before the emperors of successive reigns, I harbored no divergent intent and plotted for no rank; according to my station I exerted myself for the state;
s0013.idiomatic: Before the emperors of successive reigns, I harbored no divergent intent and plotted for no rank; according to my station I exerted myself for the state;

s0014.literal: all the princes, elder and younger brothers, and all the common people know this as well.
s0014.idiomatic: all the princes, elder and younger brothers, and all the common people know this as well.

s0015.literal: Now that my nephew the emperor has ascended to Heaven, as the princes and great ministers to the south, military officers, princely sons-in-law, officials, and Dadu commoners deliberated: the great succession ought not long remain vacant; only I am of Emperor Sechen's legitimate line, Emperor Yuzong's eldest grandson, and by precedent fit to sit in the great succession; no other brothers contest for installation;
s0015.idiomatic: Now that my nephew the emperor has ascended to Heaven, as the princes and great ministers to the south, military officers, princely sons-in-law, officials, and Dadu commoners deliberated: the great succession ought not long remain vacant; only I am of Emperor Sechen's legitimate line, Emperor Yuzong's eldest grandson, and by precedent fit to sit in the great succession; no other brothers contest for installation;

s0016.literal: thus, amid the imperial demise, before order could be restored, men's hearts are hard to fathom; it is fitting to appease the common people and settle the hearts of all under Heaven; early installation was proposed here; following the hearts of the multitude, on the fourth day of the ninth month, in Chinggis Khan's great ordo, I took my seat in the great succession.
s0016.idiomatic: thus, amid the imperial demise, before order could be restored, men's hearts are hard to fathom; it is fitting to appease the common people and settle the hearts of all under Heaven; early installation was proposed here; following the hearts of the multitude, on the fourth day of the ninth month, in Chinggis Khan's great ordo, I took my seat in the great succession.

s0017.literal: That the common people may be at ease, an amnesty edict is issued.
s0017.idiomatic: That the common people may be at ease, an amnesty edict is issued.

s0018.literal: That day, privy council administrator and Prince of Qiyang Yesen Temür was made central secretariat right chancellor; Prince Yelu Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Anxi.
s0018.idiomatic: That day, privy council administrator and Prince of Qiyang Yesen Temür was made central secretariat right chancellor; Prince Yelu Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Anxi.

s0019.literal: On jiawu day palace secretary Dilqash was made central secretariat grand councillor; Naimatai was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Teshi was made privy council administrator; Masihu was made associate privy council administrator; Boluo was made Xuanhui Court commissioner; Xumaijie was made Xuanzheng Court commissioner.
s0019.idiomatic: On jiawu day palace secretary Dilqash was made central secretariat grand councillor; Naimatai was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; Teshi was made privy council administrator; Masihu was made associate privy council administrator; Boluo was made Xuanhui Court commissioner; Xumaijie was made Xuanzheng Court commissioner.

s0020.literal: On yiwei day the Luo barbarians of Dali Prefecture raided.
s0020.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Luo barbarians of Dali Prefecture raided.

s0021.literal: Associate privy council administrator Asan was made censor-in-chief; palace secretary Shanseng was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.
s0021.idiomatic: Associate privy council administrator Asan was made censor-in-chief; palace secretary Shanseng was made central secretariat left vice chancellor.

s0022.literal: On dingyou day Wanze was made privy council administrator; Tuman was made associate privy council administrator.
s0022.idiomatic: On dingyou day Wanze was made privy council administrator; Tuman was made associate privy council administrator.

s0023.literal: On wuxu day Sadu Mishi was made privy council administrator; Zhangtai was made associate privy council administrator.
s0023.idiomatic: On wuxu day Sadu Mishi was made privy council administrator; Zhangtai was made associate privy council administrator.

s0024.literal: On jihai day an edict instructed the hundred offices, "In all appointments and conferrals of office, follow Shizu's old system; only the privy council, censorate, Xuanzheng Court, and Xuanhui Court may memorialize directly; all the rest shall go through the central secretariat.
s0024.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict instructed the hundred offices, "In all appointments and conferrals of office, follow Shizu's old system; only the privy council, censorate, Xuanzheng Court, and Xuanhui Court may memorialize directly; all the rest shall go through the central secretariat.

s0025.literal: " On xinchou day Ma'asha was made privy council administrator; Shitu'er was made minister of agriculture.
s0025.idiomatic: " On xinchou day Ma'asha was made privy council administrator; Shitu'er was made minister of agriculture.

s0026.literal: Twenty-four persons among princely household officials who had been banished to distant places and those who had returned to their original registers were summoned back to the capital.
s0026.idiomatic: 24 persons among princely household officials who had been banished to distant places and those who had returned to their original registers were summoned back to the capital.

s0027.literal: That year, the great wanhu office of Daining's Mongolian households lost livestock to wind and snow; one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain were granted in relief.
s0027.idiomatic: That year, the great wanhu office of Daining's Mongolian households lost livestock to wind and snow; 150,000 shi of grain were granted in relief.

s0028.literal: Nankang and Zhangzhou two circuits suffered flooding; dependent counties of Huai'an and Yangzhou suffered famine; relief was given.
s0028.idiomatic: Nankang and Zhangzhou two circuits suffered flooding; dependent counties of Huai'an and Yangzhou suffered famine; relief was given.

s0029.literal: Winter, tenth month, on guihai day Buddhist rites were performed at the Great Bright Hall.
s0029.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on guihai day Buddhist rites were performed at the Great Bright Hall.

s0030.literal: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to Dadu to announce the accession to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples and altars of soil and grain; the traitors Yesen Temür, Wanzhe, Suonan, Tuman, and others were executed at the traveling palace.
s0030.idiomatic: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to Dadu to announce the accession to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples and altars of soil and grain; the traitors Yesen Temür, Wanzhe, Suonan, Tuman, and others were executed at the traveling palace.

s0031.literal: Xumaijie was made central secretariat right chancellor; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left chancellor Tuhulu and Communications Bureau commissioner Niuzhe were both made censor-in-chief; Susu was made associate censor-in-chief.
s0031.idiomatic: Xumaijie was made central secretariat right chancellor; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat left chancellor Tuhulu and Communications Bureau commissioner Niuzhe were both made censor-in-chief; Susu was made associate censor-in-chief.

s0032.literal: Xumaijie and Niuzhe were dispatched to execute the traitors Teshi, Shitu'er, Chijin Temür, Tuohuochi, Zhangtai, and others at Dadu; their descendants were also executed, and their household property was registered and confiscated.
s0032.idiomatic: Xumaijie and Niuzhe were dispatched to execute the traitors Teshi, Shitu'er, Chijin Temür, Tuohuochi, Zhangtai, and others at Dadu; their descendants were also executed, and their household property was registered and confiscated.

s0033.literal: On jisi day Venus encroached upon Kang.
s0033.idiomatic: On jisi day Venus encroached upon Kang.

s0034.literal: On wuchen day Temür Buhua, King of Gaochang and protector-general, was summoned.
s0034.idiomatic: On wuchen day Temür Buhua, King of Gaochang and protector-general, was summoned.

s0035.literal: On renshen day palace secretary Andachu was made grand preceptor and privy council administrator.
s0035.idiomatic: On renshen day palace secretary Andachu was made grand preceptor and privy council administrator.

s0036.literal: On bingzi day Venus encroached upon Di.
s0036.idiomatic: On bingzi day Venus encroached upon Di.

s0037.literal: An edict directed the hundred offices to observe Shizu's established regulations.
s0037.idiomatic: An edict directed the hundred offices to observe Shizu's established regulations.

s0038.literal: On guiwei day Xumaijie was additionally appointed darughachi of the Asud Guard.
s0038.idiomatic: On guiwei day Xumaijie was additionally appointed darughachi of the Asud Guard.

s0039.literal: On bingxu day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wubadu was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0039.idiomatic: On bingxu day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wubadu was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0040.literal: Yao troops of Eight Circuits, Shunyuan, and the routes of Jingjiang, Dali, and Weichu raided; edicts directed the Huguang and Yunnan two provinces to summon and instruct them.
s0040.idiomatic: Yao troops of Eight Circuits, Shunyuan, and the routes of Jingjiang, Dali, and Weichu raided; edicts directed the Huguang and Yunnan two provinces to summon and instruct them.

s0041.literal: Jiangdu County of Yangzhou Prefecture caught fire; the guard households of the Princes of Yunnan and Xiping suffered famine; relief was given in all cases.
s0041.idiomatic: Jiangdu County of Yangzhou Prefecture caught fire; the guard households of the Princes of Yunnan and Xiping suffered famine; relief was given in all cases.

s0042.literal: Eleventh month, on jichou new moon, Mars encroached upon Kang.
s0042.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on jichou new moon, Mars encroached upon Kang.

s0043.literal: The imperial carriage halted at Zhongdu; Buddhist rites were performed at the Kungang Hall.
s0043.idiomatic: The imperial carriage halted at Zhongdu; Buddhist rites were performed at the Kungang Hall.

s0044.literal: On gengyin day Venus encroached upon Hooked Clasp.
s0044.idiomatic: On gengyin day Venus encroached upon Hooked Clasp.

s0045.literal: On bingshen day the imperial carriage halted at Zugui.
s0045.idiomatic: On bingshen day the imperial carriage halted at Zugui.

s0046.literal: On yiwei day Venus encroached upon Eastern Wall.
s0046.idiomatic: On yiwei day Venus encroached upon Eastern Wall.

s0047.literal: On xinchou day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.
s0047.idiomatic: On xinchou day the imperial carriage reached Dadu.

s0048.literal: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Di.
s0048.idiomatic: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Di.

s0049.literal: Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys to court.
s0049.idiomatic: Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys to court.

s0050.literal: On dingwei day the Emperor held audience at the Great Bright Hall and received congratulations from the princes and the hundred offices.
s0050.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Emperor held audience at the Great Bright Hall and received congratulations from the princes and the hundred offices.

s0051.literal: On gengxu day an edict directed the hundred offices to attend to affairs morning and evening without neglect.
s0051.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict directed the hundred offices to attend to affairs morning and evening without neglect.

s0052.literal: On xinhai day Associate Censor-in-Chief Dong Shouyong, for association with Teshi, was dismissed from office.
s0052.idiomatic: On xinhai day Associate Censor-in-Chief Dong Shouyong, for association with Teshi, was dismissed from office.

s0053.literal: On renzi day an edict directed that construction and repairs not urgently needed be halted.
s0053.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict directed that construction and repairs not urgently needed be halted.

s0054.literal: On guichou day an envoy was dispatched to Qufu to sacrifice to Confucius with the highest victim.
s0054.idiomatic: On guichou day an envoy was dispatched to Qufu to sacrifice to Confucius with the highest victim.

s0055.literal: An edict directed the Huifu Court to install the image of Prince of Beian Namuhan at Gaoliang River Temple and sacrifice to the Five Fortunes Spirits of Dunjia.
s0055.idiomatic: An edict directed the Huifu Court to install the image of Prince of Beian Namuhan at Gaoliang River Temple and sacrifice to the Five Fortunes Spirits of Dunjia.

s0056.literal: On jiayin day Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys to court.
s0056.idiomatic: On jiayin day Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys to court.

s0057.literal: On yimao day a comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0057.idiomatic: On yimao day a comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0058.literal: On bingchen day Associate Censor-in-Chief Susu, for greed and debauchery, was dismissed from office.
s0058.idiomatic: On bingchen day Associate Censor-in-Chief Susu, for greed and debauchery, was dismissed from office.

s0059.literal: On dingsi day the commoner Fan Changdi of Xinhui County, Guangzhou Route, raised rebellion; Guangdong Vice Marshal Umar'er led troops to capture him.
s0059.idiomatic: On dingsi day the commoner Fan Changdi of Xinhui County, Guangzhou Route, raised rebellion; Guangdong Vice Marshal Umar'er led troops to capture him.

s0060.literal: More than six thousand persons under Da'aai, A'sanmu, and Tailongmai of Kainan Prefecture raided the Aibai Salt Wells.
s0060.idiomatic: More than 6,000 persons under Da'aai, A'sanmu, and Tailongmai of Kainan Prefecture raided the Aibai Salt Wells.

s0061.literal: Edict: "All who confess their crimes shall be pardoned.
s0061.idiomatic: Edict: "All who confess their crimes shall be pardoned.

s0062.literal: " Yichun County of Yuanzhou Route and Dantu County of Zhenjiang Route suffered famine; forty-nine thousand shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.
s0062.idiomatic: " Yichun County of Yuanzhou Route and Dantu County of Zhenjiang Route suffered famine; 49,000 shi of grain were issued and sold at reduced prices for relief.

s0063.literal: Qianyang County of Yuan Prefecture suffered famine; the Shaobo garrison-farm fields suffered drought; relief was given in both cases.
s0063.idiomatic: Qianyang County of Yuan Prefecture suffered famine; the Shaobo garrison-farm fields suffered drought; relief was given in both cases.

s0064.literal: Twelfth month, on jiwei day Censorate secretary Duo'erzhiban, censors Sa'ertahan, Uduman, and Guo Yesen Hudu were all dismissed from office for association with Teshi.
s0064.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiwei day Censorate secretary Duo'erzhiban, censors Sa'ertahan, Uduman, and Guo Yesen Hudu were all dismissed from office for association with Teshi.

s0065.literal: The censors said, "Formerly when Temüder monopolized government, he falsely executed Yang Duo'erzhi, Xiao Baizhu, He Boyan, Guanyinbao, and Soqar Qadirmishi, tattooed and banished Li Qianheng and Cheng Gui, and dismissed Wang Yi and Gao Fang and Zhang Zhibi; all under Heaven knew their innocence — we request that their names be cleared.
s0065.idiomatic: The censors said, "Formerly when Temüder monopolized government, he falsely executed Yang Duo'erzhi, Xiao Baizhu, He Boyan, Guanyinbao, and Soqar Qadirmishi, tattooed and banished Li Qianheng and Cheng Gui, and dismissed Wang Yi and Gao Fang and Zhang Zhibi; all under Heaven knew their innocence — we request that their names be cleared.

s0066.literal: " An edict directed that the living be summoned back and restored to office, and the dead be posthumously conferred offices in graded amounts.
s0066.idiomatic: " An edict directed that the living be summoned back and restored to office, and the dead be posthumously conferred offices in graded amounts.

s0067.literal: Prince Xue Chegan was granted his late father's former gold seal.
s0067.idiomatic: Prince Xue Chegan was granted his late father's former gold seal.

s0068.literal: On gengshen day the eunuch Gangdali was made Zhongzheng Court commissioner.
s0068.idiomatic: On gengshen day the eunuch Gangdali was made Zhongzheng Court commissioner.

s0069.literal: On renxu day the guard households of the latent residence were granted notes, sixty ingots per man.
s0069.idiomatic: On renxu day the guard households of the latent residence were granted notes, 60 ingots per man.

s0070.literal: The Zhenjiang Route canal and Lian Lake were dredged, employing thirteen thousand five hundred corvée laborers.
s0070.idiomatic: The Zhenjiang Route canal and Lian Lake were dredged, employing 13,500 corvée laborers.

s0071.literal: Prince Balasiri was granted a seal.
s0071.idiomatic: Prince Balasiri was granted a seal.

s0072.literal: On wuchen day posthumous titles for the imperial father and imperial mother were requested at the southern suburb; the imperial father, Prince of Jin, was styled Emperor Guang Sheng Renxiao, temple name Xianzong; the imperial mother, Princess of Jin, was styled Empress Xuanyi Shusheng.
s0072.idiomatic: On wuchen day posthumous titles for the imperial father and imperial mother were requested at the southern suburb; the imperial father, Prince of Jin, was styled Emperor Guang Sheng Renxiao, temple name Xianzong; the imperial mother, Princess of Jin, was styled Empress Xuanyi Shusheng.

s0073.literal: On jisi day Mercury encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
s0073.idiomatic: On jisi day Mercury encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

s0074.literal: On gengwu day, because of the accession, great gifts were bestowed upon empresses, consorts, princes, and the hundred offices — more than seven hundred ingots of gold, thirty-three thousand ingots of silver, and cash and silks and cloths in corresponding amounts.
s0074.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because of the accession, great gifts were bestowed upon empresses, consorts, princes, and the hundred offices — more than 700 ingots of gold, 33,000 ingots of silver, and cash and silks and cloths in corresponding amounts.

s0075.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.
s0075.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.

s0076.literal: Thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole the gold spirit tablets of Emperor Renzong and Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred.
s0076.idiomatic: Thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole the gold spirit tablets of Emperor Renzong and Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred.

s0077.literal: On xinwei day Mars encroached upon Fang.
s0077.idiomatic: On xinwei day Mars encroached upon Fang.

s0078.literal: On renshen day a spirit tablet for Emperor Renzong was made, and the relevant offices were still ordered to pursue and capture the thieves.
s0078.idiomatic: On renshen day a spirit tablet for Emperor Renzong was made, and the relevant offices were still ordered to pursue and capture the thieves.

s0079.literal: A comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0079.idiomatic: A comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0080.literal: On guiyou day Liu Yin and others of the Yao of Longshui County, Deqing Route, surrendered.
s0080.idiomatic: On guiyou day Liu Yin and others of the Yao of Longshui County, Deqing Route, surrendered.

s0081.literal: On jiaxu day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was ordered to perform jiao rites.
s0081.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was ordered to perform jiao rites.

s0082.literal: On yihai day Eastern Yi tribesmen presented fur pelts and came to submit.
s0082.idiomatic: On yihai day Eastern Yi tribesmen presented fur pelts and came to submit.

s0083.literal: Grand Ceremony Court ministers said, "Since Emperor Shizu, the Imperial Ancestral Temple had only one offering per year; the previous emperor restored the ancient system of four offerings per year — we request a decision.
s0083.idiomatic: Grand Ceremony Court ministers said, "Since Emperor Shizu, the Imperial Ancestral Temple had only one offering per year; the previous emperor restored the ancient system of four offerings per year — we request a decision.

s0084.literal: " The Emperor said, "Sacrifice is a great affair — how dare I simplify its rites.
s0084.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "Sacrifice is a great affair — how dare I simplify its rites.

s0085.literal: " An order directed that four offerings still be performed.
s0085.idiomatic: " An order directed that four offerings still be performed.

s0086.literal: Surveillance censors Tuotuo, Zhao Chengqing, and others said, "Temüder in the previous reign harbored a treacherous heart, estranged the imperial fiefs, executed great ministers, left the previous emperor isolated, and at last brought great calamity.
s0086.idiomatic: Surveillance censors Tuotuo, Zhao Chengqing, and others said, "Temüder in the previous reign harbored a treacherous heart, estranged the imperial fiefs, executed great ministers, left the previous emperor isolated, and at last brought great calamity.

s0087.literal: His son Suonan personally joined the treasonous plot and long evaded Heaven's punishment — we request that his crime be corrected to satisfy the hearts of the common people.
s0087.idiomatic: His son Suonan personally joined the treasonous plot and long evaded Heaven's punishment — we request that his crime be corrected to satisfy the hearts of the common people.

s0088.literal: Yelu, Tutuha, and Sudun are all Teshi's faction and ought not be pardoned.
s0088.idiomatic: Yelu, Tutuha, and Sudun are all Teshi's faction and ought not be pardoned.

s0090.literal: On bingzi day Prince Cheche Tu of the Lingbei frontier garrisons was ordered to perform Buddhist rites monthly to repel invading troops.
s0090.idiomatic: On bingzi day Prince Cheche Tu of the Lingbei frontier garrisons was ordered to perform Buddhist rites monthly to repel invading troops.

s0091.literal: On jimao day monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites within the inner palace to quell thunder.
s0091.idiomatic: On jimao day monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites within the inner palace to quell thunder.

s0092.literal: The annual grants of gold, silver, silks, and cloths to Prince Xue Chegan, imperial son-in-law Habo, and others were increased in graded amounts.
s0092.idiomatic: The annual grants of gold, silver, silks, and cloths to Prince Xue Chegan, imperial son-in-law Habo, and others were increased in graded amounts.

s0093.literal: On xinsi day Mars encroached upon Eastern Wall.
s0093.idiomatic: On xinsi day Mars encroached upon Eastern Wall.

s0094.literal: On renwu day Prince Yuesibie dispatched Qielie to court; gold and silks were granted.
s0094.idiomatic: On renwu day Prince Yuesibie dispatched Qielie to court; gold and silks were granted.

s0095.literal: On guiwei day Cen Shixing, grand commissioner of Lai'an Route on the Right River of Guangxi, dispatched his younger brother Shiyuan to court with tribute.
s0095.idiomatic: On guiwei day Cen Shixing, grand commissioner of Lai'an Route on the Right River of Guangxi, dispatched his younger brother Shiyuan to court with tribute.

s0096.literal: Prince Yelu Temür was banished to Yunnan, Atipeihua to Hainan, Qulübuhua to Nurgan, Boluo and Ulus Bughua to island territories — all for complicity in the treasonous plot with Teshi and others.
s0096.idiomatic: Prince Yelu Temür was banished to Yunnan, Atipeihua to Hainan, Qulübuhua to Nurgan, Boluo and Ulus Bughua to island territories — all for complicity in the treasonous plot with Teshi and others.

s0097.literal: On yiyou day the Cheli tribesman Yu Meng raided; an edict directed summoning and instructing them.
s0097.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Cheli tribesman Yu Meng raided; an edict directed summoning and instructing them.

s0098.literal: The hundred offices were instructed not to borrow titles and insignia, each observing Shizu's fixed regulations.
s0098.idiomatic: The hundred offices were instructed not to borrow titles and insignia, each observing Shizu's fixed regulations.

s0099.literal: On bingxu day Xumaijie said, "In the recent affair of Yesen Temür's rebellion, Prince Buyan fled to the latent residence and wished to devote his life to the utmost; he also said that unless the chief culprit were removed, Your Majesty's fine name would not stand forth — how would later ages and all under Heaven come to know?
s0099.idiomatic: On bingxu day Xumaijie said, "In the recent affair of Yesen Temür's rebellion, Prince Buyan fled to the latent residence and wished to devote his life to the utmost; he also said that unless the chief culprit were removed, Your Majesty's fine name would not stand forth — how would later ages and all under Heaven come to know?

s0100.literal: This accorded with the imperial mind; he had once received commendation.
s0100.idiomatic: This accorded with the imperial mind; he had once received commendation.
